t: What Architectural Space Planning Database Is All About
title: What Architectural Space Planning Database Is All About
description: Space planning arranges rooms by relationship: adjacency matrices score which departments must neighbor (OR next to ICU), circulation separates flows (public, staff, service), and utilization data (badge swipes, sensors) rightsizes.
